Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence. Source: target_dictionary and component_sequences. Join: target_dictionary.tid = target_components.tid and target_components.component_id = component_sequences.component_id. Filter: target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Sort: target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
